dialogues.speaker: Immature Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Faustier is totally ripped! How hard do I have to work to be as strong as he is?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Don't assume he was always so buff. He used to be skinny as a rail. He only became this muscular after he got sent to the Fortress of Meropide."

dialogues.speaker: Immature Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Wow! Then I want to go to the Fortress of Meropide too!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Now that's easy, all you have to do is..."

dialogues.speaker: Faustier
dialogues.text: "Don't listen to their baloney! All you have to do is eat well, get lots of exercise, and you'll be as strong as I am!"
